Name: Flora.The.Cavalier
Author: CrusadingBanana
Description:
[b][size=4]Flora.The.Cavalier[/size][/b]
Grow adorable Cavalier King Charles Spaniel-inspired plants on your Stardew Valley farm!
This mod adds five unique Cavalier flower variants, each inspired by a different coat colour. Four variants have equal chances of appearing, while one extremely rare variant has only a 4% chance!
Features
[list]
[*]Five Cavalier-inspired flower variants.[/*]
[*]Four common variants (24% chance each).[/*]
[*]One super-rare variant (4% chance).[/*]
[*]Custom item category: Cute dog.[/*]
[*]Cavalier flowers are universally loved gifts.[/*]
[*]Additional friendship points when gifting Cavalier flowers - a full heart![/*]
[/list]Requirements
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.5.2 or later[/*]
[*]Content Patcher 2.9.0 or later[/*]
[/list]Installation
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Install Content Patcher.[/*]
[*]Download and extract Flora.The.Cavalier.[/*]
[*]Place both mod folders into your Stardew Valley /mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]Credits
Created by Amelka and Radek.
